description: This file provides a centralized mechanism for managing authentication tokens and organization identifiers stored in localStorage. It exposes functions to get, set, and clear auth tokens and organization IDs, as well as to build auth headers for API requests. It also maintains legacy keys for backward compatibility.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the stored JWT token from localStorage or null if not logged in.

methods.name: getOrganizationId
methods.description: Returns the active organization ID from localStorage, prioritizing the current key and falling back to legacy key.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Legacy helper that returns the organization ID using the previous key naming.

methods.name: setFromLoginResponse
methods.description: Stores auth token and organization/tenant ID from login response into localStorage, updating both current and legacy keys.

methods.name: setActiveOrganizationId
methods.description: Stores the provided organization ID into localStorage and maintains legacy key synchronization; removes if null.

methods.name: setActiveTenantId
methods.description: Legacy alias that maps to setActiveOrganizationId, used for setting tenant ID.

methods.name: clearAuth
methods.description: Removes the authentication token from localStorage, effectively logging the user out.

methods.name: buildAuthHeaders
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers including the Authorization bearer token if available; does not include tenant info.
